sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:218674
Court No. - 72
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 12580 of 2023

Applicant :- Dinesh Maurya
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Chandra Shekhar Kushwaha,Gyan Chandra Verma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1. List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Chandra Shekhar Kushwaha, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri R.P. Patel,
learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 263 of 2023, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 409 of IPC, Police Station Kotwali,
District Maharajganj, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

4. At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant has claimed parity with the co-accused Smt.
Sushila, who has already been granted anticipatory bail by learned Additional Sessions Judge,
Dinesh Maurya vs State Of U.P. on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59823003/
1 (F.T.C. No.1), Maharajganj in Bail Application No. 1006 of 2023 vide order dated 20.06.2023.

entities.text: Dinesh Maurya vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The case of the applicant is at par with the co-accused but his anticipatory bail application was rejected by the court concerned only on the ground of his criminal history.
Learned counsel has also stated that the applicant has criminal history of four cases which has been explained in the affidavit.
5. The prayer for anticipatory bail has been vehemently opposed by learned AGA.
However, the aforesaid factual aspect of the parity to the co-accused has not been disputed by him.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, the judgement passed by this Court in Nanha S/o Nabhan Kha vs. State of U.P., 1993 Crl.L.J. 938 and the judgement passed by the Apex Court in Paras Ram Vishnoi vs. The Director,

entities.text: Nanha S/o Nabhan Kha vs. State of U.P., 1993 Crl.L.J. 938
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Paras Ram Vishnoi vs. The Director,
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Central
Bureau of Investigation, MANU/SCOR/22410/2021
, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant is entitled to be granted anticipatory bail in this case.
The bail application is allowed on the ground of parity.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the anticipatory bail of the applicant.

9. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of Dinesh Maurya vs State Of U.P. on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59823003/
2
